headline: Unsealed filings show internal warnings over AI scraping of news content
summary: Two reports describe newly unsealed court documents in the New York Times' case against OpenAI and Microsoft. Internal material characterized AI scraping as the largest theft of labor in human history and warned it would damage publishers and the web. The outlets differ on attribution: one says a Microsoft executive applied the phrase to OpenAI's practices, the other that it came from the companies' own documentation.
